# Philly Draft Cleaners

> Philly Draft Cleaners LLC is a draft beer line cleaning company in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. It cleans draft beer systems for bars, restaurants, breweries, coworking spaces, and venues. Owner and technician Mike Hanson completed Micro Matic's Dispense Institute training (Dispense Specialist Program).

## Services

- Bi-weekly draft line cleaning: caustic cleaner pumped through the lines with a Micro Matic recirculating pump, following Brewers Association guidelines. Faucets and couplers are taken apart and hand-cleaned at every visit.
- Quarterly acid cleaning to remove beer stone.
- Line, faucet, coupler, and seal inspection at every visit.
- A cleaning certificate left after every visit (date, technician, method), as required by 40 Pa. Code 5.52.
- Free on-site estimates.
- Works on long-draw glycol systems, direct-draw coolers, and kegerators.

## Service area

Philadelphia, including Center City, Fishtown, Northern Liberties, Old City, and South Philly.
